business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Consignment and Secondhand Luxury Goods Retail

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Egypt (unified national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax or company registry distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Bilateral Investment Treaty - United States of America and Egypt (entered into force 1992)
Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement - United Kingdom and Egypt (1975)
Bilateral Investment Treaty - People's Republic of China and Egypt (1996)
Agadir Agreement for the Mediterranean Arab States (2007)
Pan-Arab Free Trade Area (GAFTA), in force for Egypt

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014, Law No. 8 of 2015 and Law No. 154 of 2019, together with its Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 39 of 2003, as amended); binding circulars and beneficial-owner verification rules of the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU); Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, Articles 30-32 (shareholder register, transfer and disclosure); Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT regulatory framework applicable to the opening of corporate bank accounts. UBO piercing methodology: the statutory 25% ownership threshold applies to both direct and indirect beneficial ownership; ownership must be traced through any interposed legal entities until a natural person is identified; where no natural person emerges at the 25% level, control-based attribution applies to senior managing officials, persons holding effective veto rights, and persons empowered to dispose of company assets; employee shareholder de-minimis exemptions do not apply.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Commercial Registry Extract issued for each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registrar in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Egypt is not a ratifying party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; apostille certificates are NOT accepted by Egyptian authorities)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board or Shareholders Resolution authorizing the formation of the Egyptian LLC, appointing the Manager, and approving the UBO register schedule
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or board of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (home-country Notary Public then home-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs then Egyptian Embassy/Consulate then sworn Arabic translation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney granted to resident Egyptian counsel for executing incorporation filings and banking KYC on behalf of foreign founders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copies of the passport pages of all natural-person founders and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the passport-holder's country of residence, or the passport issuing authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or, at minimum, notarization supplemented by accredited Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Aged bank reference letter and source-of-wealth letter for each UBO holding 25% or more of the LLC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank of the UBO in his or her country of ordinary residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory for all founders, directors and UBOs: (a) PEP classification under Article 3 of AML Law No. 80 of 2002 covering Egyptian, foreign and international-organization senior public officials and their family members and close associates; (b) screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated Lists, the OFAC SDN list, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the national Egyptian terrorist-entity designations published by EMLCU; (c) enhanced due diligence on transactions above EGP 350,000 and on any consignment of luxury goods sourced from or destined to a high-risk third country; (d) retention of a completed AML questionnaire and source-of-funds declaration in the incorporation file for the appointed bank's onboarding review. The vintage luxury resale activity does not require a standalone statutory license under Egyptian law beyond standard commercial registry and tax registration, but carries a Medium_Risk_Enhanced banking classification.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Invest in Egypt digital platform at www.investinegypt.gov.eg; physical filings at the GAFI One-Stop-Shop, 3 Salah Salem Road, Nasr City, Cairo.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Arabic is the sole authoritative registry language. The Arabic trade name must be composed in Arabic script, be pronounceable, contain no contradictions with existing registered marks, and follow the pattern 'Trade Name for Trading - LLC' (شركة ذات مسئولية محدودة). Latin-script transliteration is permitted only as a secondary international-trade field and does not replace the Arabic name; a name submitted solely in Latin script will be rejected.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Misr (when used as leading nomenclature connoting state ownership)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the filer may submit a written reconsideration request to the GAFI One-Stop-Shop name clearance committee within 15 days of the rejection decision; a substitute name may be filed in parallel without prejudice. If the reconsideration is refused, the applicant may lodge an administrative annulment action before the Egyptian Council of State (Administrative Court) under Law No. 49 of 1973 within 60 days of the written refusal notification. An approved name may be extended once for an additional 30-day period upon written application submitted before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual or mail-forwarding-only address is not accepted for GAFI registration of an LLC. A physical registered office located in Egypt is mandatory. A serviced office or business center leasing a dedicated physical suite is acceptable for the e-commerce segment, provided the lease agreement and a caretaker-authorized manager are documented; the vintage luxury consignment business must additionally evidence a licensed storage or receiving address for consigned inventory to satisfy Commercial Registry substance expectations. No standalone activity-specific statutory license is triggered for the online consignment model beyond commercial registry and tax registration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 25% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months, driven by the online retail DNFBP risk rating and the consignment-inventory holding business model; inspections may be conducted under the AML supervisory framework with minimal prior notice.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 180 of 2022 (mainly Articles covering limited liability companies, formation, quota capital, and board governance), as supplemented by its Executive Regulations issued under Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2372 of 2023; read with the Commercial Code (Law No. 17 of 1999) on Commercial Registry (CRC) registration and the Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 on GAFI one-stop-shop facilitation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Investor Services Center / One-Stop-Shop, in coordination with the Commercial Registry Office of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association (Company Contract / Ain Contract) plus the official Incorporation Application Form filed electronically through GAFI's one-stop-shop portal (COMPASS / investor services).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to LLCs under Law 180 of 2022; the declared quota capital must be fully subscribed and paid into a temporary escrow deposit account at an Egyptian licensed bank before incorporation, and the Capital Deposit Certificate must be lodged with the GAFI one-stop-shop. Non-resident founders may contribute in foreign currency through the same escrow mechanism.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED at the First Board Meeting of the Company held at the registered office on [DATE]: (1) The Founding Members' subscription schedule for the paid-up quota capital is approved, and the capital deposit certificate issued by the escrow bank is ratified. (2) The registered office located in the Governorate of Cairo, Arab Republic of Egypt, is adopted as the Company's statutory headquarters. (3) The following officers are appointed: Managing Director, Company Secretary, and AML/CFT Compliance Officer, each authorized to execute formation filings, open corporate bank accounts, and bind the Company in routine transactions. (4) The Managing Director is authorized to complete the Commercial Registry, Tax Authority, and Social Insurance registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI - Corporate Names Reservation Department (electronic submission via the GAFI investor portal and COMPASS web application)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three alternative Arabic and English corporate names through the GAFI portal; complete the AML/UBO information questionnaire; pay the name reservation fee by e-payment; download the Name Reservation Certificate valid for 90 days. Retain a printed copy for the notary and the bank escrow account opening.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID copies of all founding members (notarized where applicable)
Proposed names list (three alternatives in Arabic and English)
AML/UBO disclosure form
Power of Attorney authorizing the applicant or presenting counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for prior registration, religious incompatibility, or official language non-conformity, refile within 3 working days with a fresh list of candidates; alternatively request a preliminary name search report and escalate to the GAFI ombudsman window if the rejection contravenes published naming guidelines.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution, and Notarization of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice Notary Public Office (Dar Al Wathaeq), including the on-site GAFI notary window at the Investor Services Center
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Have an Egyptian corporate lawyer prepare the Articles of Association in Arabic, together with a certified English translation; convene all founding members to execute the Company Contract before the notary; obtain notarization and stamp duty marks; produce three notarized originals for the bank, the GAFI one-stop-shop, and company records.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Certificate
Draft Articles of Association signed by all founders
Valid passports and Arabic translations for non-resident founders
Lease agreement or letter of intent for the registered office premises
Capital subscription schedule (allotment list)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the notary queries the object clause or board authority provisions, the counsel will amend the Articles to the model language under Law 180 of 2022, resubmit the corrected contract for certification, and settle any additional stamp duty before the GAFI filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Escrow Capital Deposit and Bank Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr, Commercial International Bank) acting through the GAFI one-stop-shop banking window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow account titled '[Company Name] - Under Formation'; deposit the full subscribed cash capital in Egyptian pounds or an eligible foreign currency; obtain the official Capital Deposit Certificate and bank acknowledgment of subscription. After Commercial Registry registration, instruct the bank to convert the escrow account into the corporate operating account.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Certificate
Notarized Articles of Association
Passport or national ID copies of signatories and beneficial owners
Proof of registered office address (lease contract or promise of lease)
Source of funds declaration and enhanced KYC pack due to the Medium_Risk AML rating
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank demands enhanced due diligence, provide a bank reference from the founder's home institution and an apostilled KYC package for non-resident members; if the first bank declines, move to an alternate bank window inside the GAFI one-stop-shop without losing the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and One-Stop-Shop Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center / One-Stop-Shop, electronic submission through the COMPASS portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation bundle electronically: application form, notarized Articles of Association, capital deposit certificate, registered office lease, officer consents, and AML/UBO declarations; pay the statutory fees; obtain the stamped incorporation approval and the provisional corporate file number from GAFI, which triggers automatic Commercial Registry and Tax Authority coordination.
required_dossiers: Signed incorporation application form (GAFI prescribed)
Notarized Articles of Association with Arabic and English versions
Capital Deposit Certificate
Consent and good repute letters from each appointed officer and director
First Board Resolution adopting the registered office and appointing officers
UBO declaration and AML/CFT policy outline
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a deficiency query, respond with the required corrective documentation within the 15-working-day statutory response window; a single extension may be requested in writing; final refusal may be administratively appealed to the GAFI Chairman within 30 days of the adverse notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office, Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade (Cairo CRC department), operating in synchronization with the GAFI one-stop-shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon GAFI approval, the one-stop-shop transmits the incorporation dossier to the Commercial Registry; physically deliver the notarized originals for CRC sealing; obtain the Commercial Registration Certificate containing the company's CRC number and the registered commercial activity code corresponding to ISIC 4791 (internet retail and consignment sales).
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation certificate and approval letter
Notarized Articles of Association
Capital deposit certificate
Registered office lease contract
Passport and national ID copies of directors and managers
Statement of fitness of the premises for commercial e-commerce and storage activities
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CRC officer requests amendment of the activity code or addresses, resubmit the activity description in line with the National Activities Classification; any unpaid fees are recalculated and settled immediately; formal registry corrections may be made by a corrective memorandum signed by the Managing Director.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration - Tax Card, VAT, and Withholding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) through its electronic tax registration portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic tax registration application on the ETA portal; obtain the Electronic Tax Card showing the Tax Identification Number (TIN); register for VAT at the standard 14% rate; register for withholding tax on salaries and supplier payments; retain the e-tax credentials for compatible marketplace and payment rail integration (Stripe / Escrow Pay).
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
GAFI incorporation certificate
Registered office lease contract
Managing Director's passport or national ID
Bank account certificate after escrow account conversion
Copies of e-commerce platform contracts for tax characterization
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA portal rejects or queries the submission, the tax advisor shall respond within the prescribed correction period; a provisional TIN may be issued during review; unresolved delay may be escalated to the ETA Investor Support desk for a 5-working-day expedited decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance and Labor Office Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) and the Ministry of Manpower local labor office (Cairo branch)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the LLC as an employer and open the NOSI employer file; submit Employee Registration Form (Form 1) for each founding employee; complete the establishment registration with the Ministry of Manpower and obtain the occupational safety record; display the workplace registration in the registered office.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
Tax Card / TIN certificate
Standard employment contract templates
Passport photographs and IDs of all employees and managers
Lease contract of the registered office
Occupational safety and health checklist signed by the site manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI or the labor office determines late registration, request a penalty remission under the applicable instructions and regularize the file; any classification dispute regarding staff is appealable to the competent administrative labor tribunal within 15 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Governorate Licensing Committee - Department of Commercial and Industrial Licenses (Ministry of Local Development / Cairo Governorate), coordinated with the Industrial Control Authority (ICA) for warehousing and storage components of the consignment operation.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Premises License (Tarhat / Local Commercial License) for E-Commerce Retail, Consignment Authentication Center, and Luxury Goods Storage (Class 4791 - Retail Trade via the Internet / Consignment Sales)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Environmental Licensing and Compliance Department
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Environmental Registration and Notification (no full EIA study required); the operator submits an Environmental Compliance Dossier for a warehousing and retail premises handling used luxury goods without industrial processing.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law 4 of 1994 as amended by Laws 9 of 2009 and 202 of 2020, and Ministerial Decree 44 of 2000: no unpermitted industrial wastewater discharge, office sanitary flows to municipal sewer within BOD and TSS thresholds (BOD not exceeding 350 mg/L where consent is required); no VOC-emitting treatment or dry-cleaning operations installed; municipal solid waste removed under a licensed sanitation contract per Waste Law 202 of 2020; any separated hazardous residual (e.g., leaking batteries, cleaning residues from authentication devices) must be recorded and transported by an EEAA-licensed hazardous waste carrier.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Fire Safety Certificate from the Ministry of Interior for the office, consignment authentication area, and storage racks, including approved ABC dry-chemical extinguishers and fire alarm proof; structural load inspection clearance for high-density luxury goods shelving; Ministry of Manpower occupational health and safety inspection record; first-aid training attendance register and annual premises license renewal documents.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance, Egypt - official portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; mandatory e-invoicing and e-receipt fiscal clearance portal: https://einvoice.gov.eg; customs verification counterpart: Egyptian Customs Authority (ECA) operating the Advance Cargo Information (ACI) single window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC must (1) incorporate with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) and obtain the Commercial Registry certificate; (2) file ETA Registration Form No. 1 for corporate income tax together with the VAT registration form at the competent ETA tax office, appointing an accredited resident tax representative where management is outside Egypt; (3) submit the legalized Arabic translation of the Articles of Association, GAFI certificate, commercial register extract, board resolution, and passports/power-of-attorney documents; (4) receive a single unified Egyptian Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration certificate, issued within approximately 10 business days; (5) enroll in the e-invoicing platform by obtaining a Qualified Electronic Signature Certificate (QESC), registering an API client ID and client secret, and completing the OAuth 2.0 token enrollment against the ETA sandbox before any taxable invoice is issued.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egyptian law does not provide a US-style check-the-box election or hybrid-mismatch election; an LLC is mandatorily classified as a separate taxable person subject to entity-level corporate income tax at 22.5% under Income Tax Law 91/2005, as unified by Law 206/2023. Available statutory elections are: (i) the small-business unified tax regime under Law 206/2023, permitting cash-basis accounting and simplified turnover-based tax scales for taxpayers with annual turnover up to EGP 20 million; (ii) the non-resident branch/service election under Art. 56 of Law 91/2005, allowing final gross-basis withholding taxation in lieu of a net-basis assessment; (iii) an Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) election to fix transfer-pricing margins with the ETA; and (iv) placement of the taxpayer into the ETA Large or Mid-Taxpayer Center for centralized audit treatment. Pass-through taxation is available only to Egyptian partnerships, not to LLCs; LLC shareholders are taxed only on distributed dividends.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Egyptian Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended by Law No. 3 of 2023, administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority (VAT Administration).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 of annual taxable turnover in goods and services, being the mandatory domestic VAT registration threshold under Law 67/2016 and its Executive Regulations; non-resident remote sellers of digital/electronic services and e-commerce goods to Egyptian consumers must register for VAT without any turnover threshold through the simplified non-resident VAT registration procedure.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing for all B2B sales under Ministry of Finance Decrees 318/2020 and 46/2021, and mandatory e-receipting for B2C sales under Decree 51/2021. Every e-invoice must be digitally signed with a Qualified Electronic Signature Certificate (QESC) and submitted in JSON/XML to the ETA central fiscal clearance engine through the public REST API using client ID, client secret, OAuth 2.0 token, and an HMAC-SHA256 signature envelope. The ETA validates each legal document in real time and returns a 'final' clearance state, a unique invoice hash/UUID, and a machine-readable QR code/barcode; no physical revenue stamping applies, but un-cleared invoices are legally inadmissible for input VAT deduction and trigger automatic downstream audit flags plus a fine of EGP 10,000-20,000 per non-compliant invoice.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Art. 31 of VAT Law 67/2016, goods physically exported outside Egypt and services performed for a non-resident and consumed outside Egypt, including e-commerce and digitally delivered services and the online resale of vintage/secondhand luxury goods shipped to foreign end-customers, are zero-rated at 0%. To qualify, the exporter must: (i) hold a valid VAT registration and a complete, documented purchase chain for the exported goods; (ii) physically ship the goods out of Egypt within the contractual/statutory window and obtain actual Egyptian Customs Authority release through the ACI system; (iii) receive payment in convertible foreign currency and repatriate the proceeds according to Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) instructions; and (iv) retain the full statutory documentation set and submit an electronic VAT refund application. Where vintage luxury goods were originally imported, the import VAT input deduction is recoverable only upon presentation of the import customs release and corresponding tax documentation; purchases from non-registered private consignors do not carry deductable input VAT but the subsequent export sale remains zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ACI shipment declaration) duly released by the Egyptian Customs Authority and stamped with the export customs code
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical shipment from an Egyptian sea, air, or land port to the foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by an authorized Egyptian licensed bank or correspondent bank evidencing receipt and repatriation of export proceeds in convertible foreign currency
Export sales invoice in Arabic/English together with the underlying purchase or consignment contract for the vintage luxury goods
Electronic VAT refund application form supported by purchase invoices and import declarations substantiating deductible input VAT
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA and Egyptian Customs Authority cross-match every zero-rated export invoice and e-receipt against the ACI/digital signature platform using automated risk matrices. If an export zero-rating claim fails, the ETA assesses 14% VAT on the supply, adds monthly late-payment penalties at 1% per month or part-month up to the statutory cap, and imposes a fine equal to 100%-200% of the evaded VAT together with imprisonment up to five years under Art. 72 of Law 67/2016 and the Anti-Tax Evasion Law 143/2018. Forged customs declarations, backdated bills of lading, falsified inward remittance certificates, or simulated export transactions trigger an automatic five-year retrospective clawback of any refunded VAT, immediate refund cancellation, criminal referral, joint and several liability of the signing tax representative and accountant, suspension from practicing before the ETA, and blacklisting under the e-invoicing charter.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), acting under Law No. 194 of 2020 as the national monetary, banking, and foreign-exchange regulator; the CBE supervises all licensed banks, issues trade and exchange-control instructions, operates interbank foreign-exchange systems, and enforces repatriation and anti-money-laundering rules jointly with the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit. The Egyptian Customs Authority supports FX control through the NAFEZA single-window for export and import documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains a flexible managed-float exchange-rate regime in which the EGP is broadly convertible for genuine current-account transactions through the interbank market, but capital-account movements remain controlled and evidence-intensive. Inward and outward transfers must be completed through CBE-licensed banks and supported by underlying commercial documents; profit and dividend remittances are lawful after corporate tax settlement, audited financial statements, and an ordinary annual general assembly decision, with the bank recording the remittance in the CBE balance-of-payments framework. For an Egyptian LLC engaged in vintage-luxury online resale, the main convertibility obstacles will be the absence of a fully documented import-and-export chain for styled goods, reliance on offshore payment schemes, and the need to prove that each card or escrow settlement corresponds to a real sale and not to unlicensed money transmission.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Current CBE operational instructions require all export proceeds from goods and online merchandise sales to be repatriated into Egypt within 180 days after the date of shipment as evidenced by the bill of lading or air waybill, unless an extended collection period has been approved by the receiving bank. There is no fixed statutory conversion ratio set in Law No. 194 of 2020; the operating ratio is effectively 100% collection into the Egyptian banking system, with a permitted retention of foreign currency in a CBE-approved account only when the exporter demonstrates matching genuine current obligations. Receipts not covered by a documented retention approval are converted into EGP by the receiving bank at the prevailing interbank buying rate. Failure to repatriate within the statutory window exposes the LLC to CBE penalties, customs enforcement, cancellation of the importer/exporter code, and suspension of access to bank FX.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Low as a principal treasury rail. Egypt does not recognize offshore electronic-money institution licences, and a resident Egyptian LLC may not maintain core operating funds in an offshore EMI or non-bank payment wallet without violating CBE repatriation and safeguarding obligations. Stripe is not licensed as an Egyptian bank and cannot independently settle EGP clearing; its use for e-commerce card acquiring is viable only through a CBE-licensed local acquiring arrangement under which gross proceeds are settled into an Egyptian bank account. Escrow_Pay is acceptable only as a contractual escrow mechanism; all net escrow proceeds must be transmitted to the LLC's Egyptian bank by SWIFT MT103 and must not be held offshore beyond the settlement period of the underlying transaction. A treasury model built on Payoneer, Wise, Revolut, or similar offshore rails as the primary receivable account will be rejected by Egyptian banks, regarded as unlicensed money movement, and may trigger CBE sanctions and tax audit complications.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a newly formed Egyptian LLC with non-resident shareholders, the legal representative and every ultimate beneficial owner holding 25% or more must generally attend an in-person KYC and AML intake interview at the chosen bank. Remote or fully online account opening is not a statutory right; banks accept video verification only on a discretionary basis and normally require a physical branch meeting for medium-risk enhanced due-diligence profiles such as luxury e-commerce. Non-resident directors may delegate signature authority through a notarized, apostilled or Egyptian-consulate-legalized, and Arabic-translated power of attorney to the Egyptian resident manager, but the bank may still require the UBO to appear by video for identity screening and to sign the final KYC declaration before the account is activated. All specimen signatures, UBO statements, and AML questionnaires must be completed on bank-prescribed forms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity: the LLC is held through nominee shareholders or a multi-layer non-resident holding chain, making the natural person with ultimate control unclear.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation, commercial registry extracts, register of members at every layer, signed UBO declaration, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements, complete corporate organization chart, audited financial statements of the foreign parent, and passport copies of all natural persons holding more than 25%.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction profile mismatch: online card settlements from Stripe or Escrow_Pay do not reconcile with Egyptian customs declarations and supplier invoices, creating suspicion of informal cross-border fund movement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment processor merchant agreement, detailed monthly settlement reports by transaction ID and currency, reconciliation between PSP ledgers and the LLC general ledger, NAFEZA customs declarations, commercial invoices, airway bills or bills of lading, packing lists, and independent authentication certificates for every vintage luxury item.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value luxury goods flagged for money-laundering, fraud, or handling of stolen goods through purchase and resale of tangible assets.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete chain-of-custody file: original certificates of authenticity, professional appraisal reports, supplier and consignor agreements, payment evidence to consignors, item-level pricing, VAT and import-duty evidence, and an AML compliance manual containing transaction acceptance criteria, customer risk scoring, and sanctions screening procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction exposure: buyers, suppliers, or consignors are located in cash-intensive, PEP-heavy, or sanctioned jurisdictions, causing automatic transaction-monitoring alerts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Country-risk matrix with legitimate commercial rationale, PEP and sanctions screening results, negative-media due-diligence reports, passport or commercial-register copies, source-of-funds declarations, and a written compliance policy prohibiting shell-company payments, third-party funding, or transactions routed through sanctioned intermediaries.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export and collection non-repatriation: receivables remain in offshore PSP or escrow wallets beyond the CBE 180-day window or are converted outside the Egyptian interbank market.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Monthly aging report of offshore receivables, evidence of immediate onward MT103 transmission to the Egyptian bank, timeline demonstrating settlement within the statutory window, CFO or auditor confirmation that all export receipts are recorded in Egypt, CBE bank acknowledgment forms, and proof that no foreign-exchange conversion took place outside an authorized Egyptian bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injections must be executed by direct SWIFT MT103 transfer from the non-resident shareholder's own bank account to the LLC's account at a CBE-licensed Egyptian bank, using the CBE/IMF balance-of-payments purpose code for equity participation in a resident enterprise. The receiving bank registers the inward remittance as foreign direct investment in the CBE foreign-investment tracking record, and that registration is the legal foundation for future dividend and liquidation repatriation. Third-party payments, cash deposits, and cryptocurrency conversions are not acceptable. If the injection is structured as a shareholder loan, the LLC must deliver a written loan agreement with clear repayment terms; the loan is recorded separately from equity and repayments are subject to bank documentary review and CBE foreign-exchange reporting. No notarial capital escrow is statutorily required for LLC formation, but counterparties may require a proof-of-funds escrow deposit within the Egyptian bank, recorded as a segregated capital escrow sub-account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier and trade payments must be executed by the LLC's Egyptian bank through SWIFT MT103 settlement with a valid trade purpose code, supported by the commercial invoice, logistics documentation, and customs import evidence where goods cross borders. For high-value vintage-luxury purchases where the overseas supplier requires security before shipment, the compliant rail is an irrevocable documentary letter of credit under UCP600, issued by the Egyptian bank and notified/confirmed through the supplier's bank; payment occurs against presentation of the bill of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, and any specified authentication report. EGP payments to domestic consignors, authentication houses, couriers, and customs brokers clear through the CBE RTGS system or domestic instant-payment rails. Buyer refunds on card transactions must be processed through the original acquiring chain or PSP and may not be paid from the treasury account to unrelated third parties. The LLC must maintain an active importer/exporter code; otherwise, the bank will not process USD outward remittances for merchandise purchases.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EGP forward contracts up to 12 months, permitted only with documentary proof of genuine current trade exposure.
FX swap transactions between USD and EGP used to match the timing gap between card-settlement collections and EGP operating-expense payments.
Plain-vanilla EUR/USD or GBP/USD cross-currency swaps and forwards when supplier invoices are denominated in those currencies.
European-style currency options, including purchased puts/calls, for protection of large, confirmed buy-side transactions in foreign currency.

NDFs are not permissible as the primary hedge for a resident Egyptian LLC because the EGP is a deliverable currency and CBE rules require all onshore FX hedging to settle through the interbank market rather than offshore synthetic markets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax annual return (Tax Form No. 2)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year LLC, no later than 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed late-filing penalty up to EGP 1,000 plus monthly delay interest of 2% on unpaid tax; non-payment after 60 days may trigger enforced collection and freeze of tax clearance certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and statutory books filed with investment authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) / Commercial Registry Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year LLC, no later than 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file blocks tax clearance, license renewal and banking transactions; administrative fine up to EGP 20,000; persistent default may lead to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI UBO Register / AML Compliance Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March covering the preceding calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Misstatement or late confirmation carries fines up to EGP 200,000 and may suspend shareholder approval procedures until corrected.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all LLCs with issued capital exceeding EGP 250,000 or annual revenues exceeding EGP 2,000,000; medium-risk e-commerce entities are expected to obtain annual audited financial statements as a prudent AML practice.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), substantially converged with IFRS; IFRS permitted for listed and multinational group entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under AML Law 80/2002 and GAFI regulations, the LLC must maintain a UBO register and file an annual confirmation of all ultimate beneficial owners holding 25% or more ownership, voting rights, or control; changes from share transfers must be reported to the UBO register within 30 days, with the annual statement due by 31 March.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying small businesses with gross annual revenue up to EGP 20 million may elect a presumptive turnover tax of 0.5%-3% in lieu of the 22.5% CIT. Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 grants an investment tax credit of 30%-50% of eligible capital expenditure (up to 80% in priority governorates). No dedicated e-commerce or luxury-resale exemption exists.
